topics.purpose: Define Web Base as the minimal shared HTML/CSS-oriented human-facing foundation reused by Expose modules, without introducing domain semantics or a second application framework.

operations.name: Bind canonical operation to web control

baseline: minimal browser behavior where explicitly required
semantics.reuse_rule: Expose modules reuse Web Base primitives rather than shipping incompatible private foundations.
semantics.runtime_rule: Web Base has no backend/runtime authority.
semantics.style_rule: Web Base consumes canonical style/assets rather than owning parallel theme semantics.
semantics.operation_rule: Interactive controls bind to canonical operations explicitly.
semantics.dependency_rule: JavaScript is optional per feature and not required merely to represent static/shared primitives.

invariants.rule: Expose components reuse canonical semantics and remain non-privileged projection/composition surfaces.

hard_gates.condition: control invokes hidden private backend action
style duplicated instead of canonical style reuse
feature requires arbitrary JS without owning semantic need

references.purpose: Interactive controls bind to canonical operations.
